items.original_text: Fade 3. While Lanternbearer is in play, units have Guard.
items.errata_text: Fade 3. While Lanternbearer is in play, units you control have Guard.
items.explanation: The printed text granted Guard to every unit in play, including the opponent's. It was always meant to affect only its controller's units.
